findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_search, read_page, screenshot, domain_info, pdf_to_text, email_verify, keyword_volume, business_listings, business_reviews, leads_by_tech, tech_stack, company_reviews · Private data: domain_info, pdf_to_text, business_listings, company_filings · Public sink: domain_info, email_verify, email_find, keyword_volume, tech_stack.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_search, read_page, screenshot, domain_info, pdf_to_text, email_verify, keyword_volume, business_listings, business_reviews, leads_by_tech, tech_stack, company_reviews · Private data: domain_info, pdf_to_text, business_listings, company_filings · Public sink: domain_info, email_verify, email_find, keyword_volume, tech_stack

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
